# Copy-ZbxItem

## SYNOPSIS

Copies items from one host onto other hosts.

## SYNTAX

```
Copy-ZbxItem [-SourceHost] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>> [-TargetHost] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]> [-Key <string[]>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

Exports the source host, keeps only the items with the named keys (every item when -Key is omitted; a key the source does not have is an error), and imports them (createMissing) onto each target host, one target at a time. Writes nothing unless -PassThru. Supports -WhatIf/-Confirm (ConfirmImpact Medium), once per resolved target host.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Copy every item of one host onto another

```powershell
Copy-ZbxItem -SourceHost 'web-01' -TargetHost 'web-02'
Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-02' | Select-Object Name, Key
```

The source host's items are exported (configuration.export) and imported onto each target (createMissing), so items the target already has are left alone. Triggers are not copied.

### Example 2: Copy onto the hosts a search finds, through the pipeline

```powershell
Get-ZbxHost -Name 'db-*' | Copy-ZbxItem -SourceHost 'web-01'
Get-ZbxItem -Host 'db-01' | Select-Object Name, Key
```

Piped hosts bind -TargetHost; they are collected and copied to one at a time after the pipeline ends.

### Example 3: Overwrite items the target already has

```powershell
Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Requests' | Set-ZbxItem -Units 'req' | Out-Null
Copy-ZbxItem -SourceHost 'web-01' -TargetHost 'web-02' -Force
Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-02' -Name 'Requests' | Select-Object Name, Key, Units
```

-Force also updates same-keyed items on the target (updateExisting) instead of skipping them, so a change made on the source reaches the copies.
